What each recording's page on Freesound said when it was read and saved.

The saved pages themselves are not in this repository: Freesound's pages
carry a map token of Freesound's own, and GitHub does not accept a commit
that holds it. They are kept with the owner's working files. The SHA-256
of each saved page is given here so that copy can be checked.
